status: Production localized-view migration removes the measured MRM subtree slope; overall private-memory growth remains unresolved and is not equivalent to a native leak total.

provenance.actualProductionInputs: Archived MainWindow and TrayDashboardWindow use 548 and 38 CustomResource property references respectively. The shared loader embeds the authoritative English catalog; the default ResourceLoader path normalizes resource keys.
provenance.temporaryInstrumentation: The archived measured localization harness differs from its clean backup by four CaptureTemporaryNativeHeap call sites. The temporary helper enumerates the default heap after existing checkpoints; controller enables it only for this private run.
provenance.restorationVerified: All seven archived production/launch source files and the clean localization harness were byte-identical to current source at evidence preparation; the temporary heap helper was removed.
provenance.binaryBoundary: Launch hashes identify the measured instrumented assembly. Later clean builds/tests are separate verification and are not represented by this census.
provenance.timestampBoundary: capturedAtUtc strings are copied exactly from raw native-handle observations; heap/process/GC observations are sequential, not an atomic sample.

protocol.warmup: Three language changes and a rejected attachment/rollback precede measurement.
protocol.retirement: Existing dispatcher acknowledgements and forced collections precede checkpoints; final idle waits three seconds plus the existing drain. Native shells remain live until after the final snapshot.
protocol.scope: The production language transaction and migrated compiled views run with disconnected factories. This is offscreen layout and lifetime validation, not visible rendering, hardware behavior or installed-product validation.

nativeCensus.classifier: Busy default-heap allocations with a first pointer inside one of the selected module images. Leading-pointer buckets can contain GUID/data pointers as well as vtables; they do not prove reachability or total native ownership.

previouslyRejectedOrFixedFamiliesAbsent.interpretation: All selected MarkupExtension, ChangedArgs and ClosingArgs families are absent at all eight checkpoints.

remainingNativeFindings.growthScan: No approximately linear retained leading-pointer family was identified across the eight snapshots. The five largest XAML payload-increase buckets fluctuate and finish below their cycle-12 counts at final idle. This does not establish eventual bounds or complete native reclamation.

fontFaceStep.interpretation: The only non-singleton monotonically increasing leading-pointer bucket is a late four-object step, not a per-language-change slope. Type resolved exactly in an existing offline dump with matching cached XAML symbols; its retaining reference is not established.

sharedSection.interpretation: Reaches 16 by cycle 24 and settles at 15; no continuing slope in this run.

largeAllocationLead.interpretation: This bucket continues growing during activity. Its trend resembles the earlier Intel-associated 131,351-byte allocation family, but the present bucket mixes sizes and does not identify an owner or allocation stack.
largeAllocationLead.nextDiscriminatingCheck: A bounded exact-size/owner census on the post-fix build could determine whether the previously sampled Intel-associated family still grows. No such follow-up probe is part of this artifact.

handles.interpretation: Composition remains 13 and Timer 15. Events rise mainly through cycle 24, then fluctuate around 451-456 instead of increasing once per change. Three more Thread handles and one File handle remain at idle; their owners and eventual bounds were not established. GUI counts finish below warmup.

memoryAccounting.interpretation: Private bytes increase 217.83 MB while last-GC committed increases 7.08 MB and busy default-heap payload increases 28.44 MB. Free heap space increases 166.12 MB and reported entry overhead 23.12 MB. At idle, roughly 50.98 MB of busy payload disappears while free space rises by 51.35 MB with unchanged region commitment, demonstrating reclaimed storage retained as heap capacity.
memoryAccounting.accountingLimits: Busy/free/overhead, region commitment, GC commitment and process private bytes describe overlapping or differently scoped observations. Their near numerical agreement is not exact attribution; do not add them as independent categories or equate allocated payload with a reachable leak.
memoryAccounting.largeBucketContext: The 3.89 MB bucket increase is about 13.7% of busy-payload growth and 1.8% of private-byte growth. It is a continuing allocation lead, not an explanation for the complete private-memory delta.

comparisons.priorSeriesScope: Earlier 192-change run on a different dirty build/process; only warmup and cycle-60 histograms are compared here. Intervening fixes and timing prevent a strict before/after memory savings claim. The older leading-pointer selection did not cover MRM.

smallAllocationBucket.interpretation: The earlier large small-allocation ramp is absent. This mixed-size bucket is qualitative corroboration, not exact ownership attribution.

largeAllocationBucket.interpretation: The similar coarse growth signature leaves the prior graphics allocation lead open.
